page_title: RAY 1-1 BAR | Rayo Vallecano v Barcelona 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
90+6' It seemed like Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+4' The referee Mateo Busquets awards Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) a yellow card.
90+3' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is replaced by Gerard Gumbau.
90+2' That will be all from Isi Palazon who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pacha (Rayo Vallecano).
90+2' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) is first to react to a lofted pass from Lamine Yamal, but fires his header miles over the bar from near the penalty spot.
90+2' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
90+1' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) will take the corner.

90+1' A clever lofted pass finds Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) in space inside the box. He looks up and hits a precise shot towards goal, but Augusto Batalla is equal to it and makes an easy save. Barcelona get a corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' A neat pass finds Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla denies him with a good save.
86' A goal, which was scored by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano), was disallowed due to offside.
81' The game is interrupted as Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is flagged offside.
80' Augusto Batalla leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona).
79' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Eric Garcia (Barcelona), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar.
78' The substitution is prepared. Robert Lewandowski joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
78' It is time for a substitution. Gerard Martin is on for Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).
78' Corner kick. Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is coming onto the pitch as Jorge de Frutos cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' Inigo Perez is forced to make a change. Luiz Felipe (Rayo Vallecano) is unable to continue due to injury, Oscar Valentin comes on.
74' The corner kick from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

74' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Joan Garcia was alert and the score remains the same. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
73' A cross into the box from Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is cleared.

67' 1 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Isi Palazon delivers a superb cross from the corner kick, Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself some space inside the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot. His effort goes in off the crossbar and past the helpless goalkeeper. 1:1.
67' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner.
64' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
63' The corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is hurriedly cleared.
63' A pass lands at the feet of Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
62' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Dani Olmo will be replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
62' Substitution. Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) replaces Raphinha.
59' Here is a change. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Fran Perez.
56' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
53' The attendance for today's match is 14438.
51' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Raphinha (Barcelona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
50' Raphinha (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
47' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Joan Garcia is alert and denies him with a nice save.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Unbelievable miss! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!
45+4' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Augusto Batalla comes off the line to clear the ball away.
45+3' The corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Joan Garcia.
45+2' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) commits a foul during an attacking move.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
44' Rayo Vallecano are ruled offside.
42' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
40' 0 - 1 Goal! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Augusto Batalla into the bottom left corner.
40' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
38' Having seen unsporting behavior, Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) is the recipient.
38' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) goes into the referee's book for dissent.

38' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mateo Busquets has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. That is a penalty kick for Barcelona.

34' Luiz Felipe (Rayo Vallecano) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
33' The referee awards a corner and Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes over to take it.
33' The resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
33' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and Rayo Vallecano will take a corner.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
29' Raphinha (Barcelona) tries to find Ferran Torres, but he puts too much power on the pass.

26' A nice pass finds Dani Olmo (Barcelona) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
26' Raphinha (Barcelona) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.

25' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
19' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
19' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Mateo Busquets interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
17' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
14' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

13' CHANCE! Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards the right side of the goal, but Joan Garcia produces an excellent save. The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano win a corner kick.
12' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

11' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
7' Raphinha (Barcelona) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla is equal to it and makes an easy save.
